children.text: UCTP
TRN-01 · Register a taxpayer
AC-1 Section "1 — Create a taxpayer" shows "[full name] created — mobile [mobile]."
Upon page load: "Your name" box appears. Clerk enters name-tag and clicks Save before accessing the application.
Element validations: Your name - required; initial value and error message: ASK
Functional validations: Creating a taxpayer returns HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
Steps: 1. Save name-tag Mitch-6973. 2. Open Home › Training setup › Create my data. 3. Enter Full name and Mobile. 4. Click Create taxpayer.
A1 · Function + : POST taxpayer with a unique name and mobile -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
A2 · General - : POST without full_name -> HTTP 422, detail.full_name: ASK
A3 · General - : POST without mobile -> HTTP 422, detail.mobile: ASK
A4 · Function - : POST with an empty JSON body -> HTTP 422, exact detail: ASK
W1 · Function + : Create taxpayer with "Ana ABCD Dela Cruz" and a unique mobile -> result box shows "Ana ABCD Dela Cruz created — mobile [mobile]."
W2 · Function - : Submit without Full name -> exact field message: ASK
W3 · Function - : Submit without Mobile -> exact field message: ASK
W4 · Flow - : Click Create taxpayer with both fields empty -> no taxpayer created; exact feedback: ASK
AC-2 The same taxpayer details show under My data › My taxpayers.
Functional validations: GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers returns the current name-tag's taxpayers.
Steps: 1. Create taxpayer. 2. Open My data › My taxpayers. 3. Locate the newly created taxpayer.
A5 · Store + : GET taxpayers after creation -> response contains the same taxpayer_id, full_name and mobile.
A6 · Store - : GET taxpayers under a different name-tag -> newly created taxpayer is absent.
A7 · Store - : GET taxpayers under Mitch-6973 after using a different tenant header -> taxpayer is absent; exact behavior: ASK
A8 · Store - : GET taxpayers with a missing X-User-ID header -> exact HTTP status and detail: ASK
W5 · Navigation + : Open My data › My taxpayers after creation -> same full name and mobile appear.
W6 · Store - : Reload My taxpayers after an uncommitted form entry -> unsaved taxpayer does not appear.
W7 · Navigation - : Open My taxpayers before creating any taxpayer -> empty-state text: ASK
W8 · Store - : Open My taxpayers under another name-tag -> original taxpayer does not appear.
AC-3 Spaces around the name are removed, both in the "created" message and in My data.
Functional validations: Leading and trailing spaces are removed before displaying and storing full_name.
Steps: 1. Enter a name with leading and trailing spaces. 2. Create taxpayer. 3. Check result box. 4. Check My taxpayers.
A9 · General + : POST full_name "  Ana ABCD Dela Cruz  " -> HTTP 201; stored full_name is "Ana ABCD Dela Cruz".
A10 · General - : POST a name containing only spaces -> HTTP 422; detail.full_name: ASK
A11 · General - : POST a name containing only one character -> HTTP 422; detail.full_name: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
A12 · General - : POST a name containing 101 characters -> HTTP 422; detail.full_name: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
W9 · General + : Enter "  Ana ABCD Dela Cruz  " -> result box and My taxpayers both show "Ana ABCD Dela Cruz".
W10 · General - : Enter a name containing only spaces -> exact field message: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
W11 · General - : Enter "A" -> exact field message: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
W12 · General - : Enter a 101-character name -> exact field message: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
AC-4 A mobile that's already registered is not accepted. Message: "already registered for this tenant"
Functional validations: Duplicate mobile within TAGAYTAY tenant returns HTTP 409.
Steps: 1. Create a taxpayer. 2. Reuse the same mobile for a second taxpayer. 3. Inspect the response.
A13 · Domain/Data + : Create taxpayer with a new mobile -> HTTP 201; taxpayer_id is returned.
A14 · Domain/Data - : Reuse the same mobile for a second taxpayer -> HTTP 409; detail.mobile: "already registered for this tenant".
A15 · Domain/Data - : Reuse the same mobile with a different full_name -> HTTP 409; detail.mobile: "already registered for this tenant".
A16 · Domain/Data - : Reuse the same mobile after changing the name-tag within the same tenant -> HTTP 409 or 201: ASK
W13 · Domain/Data + : Create a taxpayer using a new mobile -> result box displays the created name and mobile.
W14 · Domain/Data - : Submit an already registered mobile -> field message: "already registered for this tenant".
W15 · Domain/Data - : Submit the same registered mobile with a different name -> field message: "already registered for this tenant".
W16 · Domain/Data - : Submit an already registered mobile after changing name-tag -> exact displayed outcome: ASK
AC-5 Name accepts only 2–100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ. Message: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
Element validations: Full name - required; minimum 2 characters; maximum 100; allowed characters are letters, spaces, period, hyphen, apostrophe and Ñ.
A17 · Syntax + : POST a 2-character alphabetic name -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
A18 · Syntax - : POST a 1-character name -> HTTP 422; detail.full_name: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only".
A19 · Syntax - : POST a 101-character name -> HTTP 422; detail.full_name: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only".
A20 · Syntax - : POST a name containing "@" -> HTTP 422; detail.full_name: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only".
A21 · Syntax + : POST a 100-character name -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
W17 · Syntax + : Enter a 2-character name -> taxpayer creation result appears.
W18 · Syntax - : Enter a 1-character name -> exact field message.
W19 · Syntax - : Enter a 101-character name -> exact field message.
W20 · Syntax - : Enter a name containing "@" -> exact field message.
W21 · Syntax + : Enter a 100-character name -> taxpayer creation result appears.
AC-6 Email is optional. If typed, it needs one @ with a dot after it, 254 characters max. Message: "invalid email format"
Element validations: Email (optional) - may be empty; if supplied, one @, a dot after @, maximum 254 characters.
A22 · Syntax + : POST without email -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
A23 · Syntax + : POST with a formatted email -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
A24 · Syntax - : POST email "ana.example.com" -> HTTP 422; detail.email: "invalid email format".
A25 · Syntax - : POST email "ana@" -> HTTP 422; detail.email: "invalid email format".
A26 · Syntax - : POST email exceeding 254 characters -> HTTP 422; detail.email: "invalid email format".
W22 · Syntax + : Leave Email empty and create taxpayer -> result box displays created name and mobile.
W23 · Syntax + : Enter a formatted email and create taxpayer -> taxpayer creation result appears.
W24 · Syntax - : Enter email without @ -> exact field message: "invalid email format".
W25 · Syntax - : Enter email without a dot after @ -> exact field message: "invalid email format".
W26 · Syntax - : Enter email exceeding 254 characters -> exact field message: "invalid email format".
AC-7 A taxpayer created under my name-tag shows only for that name-tag. Under another name-tag, My data shows "None yet — create one in Training setup." and the Taxpayer lists are empty.
Functional validations: X-User-ID determines the taxpayer list returned by GET.
Steps: 1. Create taxpayer under Mitch-6973. 2. Open top bar › Change. 3. Enter Mitch-6973-other. 4. Open My data › My taxpayers.
A27 · User + : POST under Mitch-6973 and GET using Mitch-6973 -> taxpayer appears in response.
A28 · User - : GET using Mitch-6973-other -> original taxpayer absent.
A29 · User - : POST under Mitch-6973-other and GET using Mitch-6973 -> other name-tag's taxpayer absent.
A30 · User - : Change X-User-ID to an empty value -> exact HTTP status and detail: ASK
W27 · User + : Open My taxpayers under Mitch-6973 -> created taxpayer appears.
W28 · User - : Change to Mitch-6973-other and open My taxpayers -> "None yet — create one in Training setup." and empty taxpayer list.
W29 · User - : Return to Mitch-6973-other after creating a taxpayer under Mitch-6973 -> original taxpayer remains absent.
W30 · User - : Change back to Mitch-6973 -> other name-tag's taxpayer does not appear.
AC-8 Mobile accepts only 09 + 9 digits, or +639 + 9 digits. No spaces, no dashes. Message: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
Element validations: Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX) - required; accepts 09 followed by 9 digits or +639 followed by 9 digits; no spaces or dashes.
A31 · Syntax + : POST mobile "09171234567" -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
A32 · Syntax + : POST mobile "+639171234567" -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id.
A33 · Syntax - : POST mobile "0917123456" (8 digits after 09) -> HTTP 422; detail.mobile: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX".
A34 · Syntax - : POST mobile "091712345678" (10 digits after 09) -> HTTP 422; detail.mobile: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX".
A35 · Syntax - : POST mobile "0917 123 4567" -> HTTP 422; detail.mobile: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX".
A36 · Syntax - : POST mobile "0917-123-4567" -> HTTP 422; detail.mobile: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX".
W31 · Syntax + : Enter "09171234567" -> taxpayer creation result appears with that mobile.
W32 · Syntax + : Enter "+639171234567" -> taxpayer creation result appears with that mobile.
W33 · Syntax - : Enter "0917123456" -> exact field message.
W34 · Syntax - : Enter "091712345678" -> exact field message.
W35 · Syntax - : Enter "0917 123 4567" -> exact field message.
W36 · Syntax - : Enter "0917-123-4567" -> exact field message.
